interpretation.JANUS_v1_collision: Consistent with rediscovering a birthday/collision mechanism; does not outperform strong BSGS total compute on the frozen scale ladder.
interpretation.GEMINI_v0: Two independent cores without cross-core compression are compute tax, not complexity improvement.
interpretation.positive_value: The experiment localizes the next research requirement: exact cross-core hints must measurably reduce recipient-core work, and ORBIT must amortize group transitions rather than paying independent powmod for diversified probes.
